Solo Queue Practice

A free 30-day deliberate-practice program for League of Legends solo queue: one focus per game, measured, reviewed, and logged.

Start the 30-day program
30 days

Download the tracker workbook (.xlsx)

Three steps to start

  1. 01

    Log your last ten ranked games and compare your numbers against the benchmarks on the baseline page.

  2. 02

    Pick the single weakest measurable thing from the focus menu and run its drill before your next session.

  3. 03

    Play with that one focus held for two or three games, log every game, and review after.

Everything else in the program

  • Drill Library

    How many champions to play, and how to pick them, while you are practicing.

  • VOD Review

    Review your own replays in twelve minutes with a four-checkpoint routine.
